name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 7 visits over 18 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2026-06-18, at wavelengths from 0.92 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
